What changed

- In `settings.json`, we changed `chat.tools.terminal.terminalProfile.osx` to use:
```json
"path": "/bin/bash"
```
- We removed the zsh-specific `correct` and `correct_all` args, because they were clearly not being honored in practice.

Why this is the right fix

- The issue is no longer “how do we disable zsh correction?”
- The issue is “zsh is still being launched for agent terminals.”
- Forcing the agent terminal shell to `bash` removes zsh from that path entirely, so there is no autocorrection layer left to fight.

- This will only affect new agent terminal sessions.

- There are still unrelated local, unstaged edits in `mcp.json` and `settings.json`. I did not include those in the commit.
